dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) targeting Windows desktop environment; uses LINE SEQUENTIAL organization and Windows file paths, consistent with GnuCOBOL on Windows

purpose.domain_detail: Employee payroll processing: reads payroll input records, computes gross pay (with overtime at 1.5x), deductions, and net pay, then writes output records and a formatted payroll report
purpose.summary: PAYRPTRB reads employee payroll data from a flat file, calculates base pay, overtime, gross pay, deductions (SSN/Medicare, state, local, federal), and net pay for each employee. It writes processed records to an output file and generates a formatted payroll report with headings, detail lines, and totals. The program was written by Ryan Brooks as a student or coursework exercise.

notable_features: Three files: input, output, and report
Overtime calculation at 1.5x rate for hours > 40
ACCEPT WS-RUN-DATE FROM DATE for run date
Page heading and detail line structures for report
WS-RULER ruler line for column alignment debugging
Windows absolute file paths in SELECT clauses
Apparent syntax error: 88-level items used where 10-level items expected in PREV-DATE group
verdict.notes: The source is truncated at 16000 chars (line ~293 of 429). There is a suspicious block around line 010000-010200 where 88-level items are used inside a group item (PREV-DATE) where 10-level items were likely intended, suggesting a copy-paste error. No COMP-3 usage despite payroll context. The program is clearly a student assignment by Ryan Brooks given the author field, Windows desktop paths, and overall structure.
